assign.request: Markdown files render as pages in the browser: /<module>/md/<name> built into base Page, /<module>/md/ index, existing .md links lead to the rendered page. (handoff2.md item 1)
assign.now: scoping — checking non-file URLs reach the app
steps: Check non-file URLs reach the app
Find the md renderer and link-makers
Build md route into base Page (worktree)

log.msg: Check first — passed. A url that is not a file reaches the app: dev /framework/ext/Panel/md/decisions → 200 text/html (Server.js falls back to index.html); production https://monorepo.lew42.workers.dev/framework/ext/Panel/md/decisions → 200 text/html (wrangler.jsonc not_found_handling: single-page-application). A url ending in an extension is answered as a file on dev (404), so routes must not end in one.

decision.question: Which url shape renders a module's markdown?
options: /ext/Panel/md/decisions — a reserved md/ segment, with an index at md/ and subfolders (md/doc/flow)
/ext/Panel/md-decisions — one segment, nothing reserved, but no index and no subfolders
decision.why: It gives every module a free docs index at md/ and reaches doc/ and doc/method/ files; the cost (no page may have a real child named md) hits nobody — no page declares one.

decision.question: Where does the md route live?
options: A check in Page.child() before route(), building a PageMarkdown subclass (core/Page/Markdown.js)
A default route() on Page — but pages that define route() would lose it
decision.why: Every page gets it with no code of its own, including pages whose route() claims every name (the AI day pages).

decision.question: How do existing .md links lead to the rendered page?
options: Rewrite in the two link-makers: md.route() for every link inside markdown, and Router.link_clicked() for any other .md link clicked in the app
decision.why: One function each; x.md?raw still opens the file. A .md link built outside markdown keeps its .md href on hover but opens the page on click.

decision.question: Which page does a link hang its md/ off?
options: The file's module: the folder above doc/, else its own folder
The deepest folder the file shares with the page on screen (always walkable, but cross-module links become /framework/md/core/Page/…)
decision.why: Stable urls whatever page you clicked from. Measured over directory.json: 2,208 of 2,276 .md files land on a real page; 68 in 13 page-less folders would 404 — recorded in Markdown.js.

decision.question: Trailing slash on md routes?
decision.why: ext/Panel documents flow.js in doc/file/flow.js.md; /md/doc/file/flow.js is answered as a file and 404s. Every other page url on the site ends in / too, so active-link marking works.

assign.now: verified headless in the worktree — committing, then docs

assign.outcome: **Markdown files now render as pages. Add `md/` to any page's url.** [/framework/ext/Panel/md/](/framework/ext/Panel/md/) lists every markdown file in the module, and [/framework/ext/Panel/md/doc/decisions/](/framework/ext/Panel/md/doc/decisions/) renders `doc/decisions.md`. It is built into the base `Page`, so every module has it with no code of its own. Every link to a `.md` file now opens the rendered page: links inside markdown are rewritten, and the Router catches any other `.md` link that is clicked. `x.md?raw` still opens the raw file. ![the md index](/framework/ai/2026-09-24/md-pages/index.png) **Checked first:** a url that is not a real file reaches the app, both on the dev server and on production (Cloudflare's SPA fallback, both answered 200 text/html). Tested headless on the worktree and again on the live site: zero failed requests, an in-app click, a raw `.md` link, and a deliberate 404. **Chosen:** `/md/decisions/` over `md-decisions`. It gives a free index and reaches subfolders; the cost is that no page may have a child named `md`, and no page has one. Routes end in `/`, because a doc named `flow.js.md` otherwise ends in `.js` and the server answers it as a missing file. **Left, one line each:** - Production has no file list (`directory.json` exists only on the dev server), so there the index shows the module's readme instead. - 68 of 2,276 `.md` files sit in 13 folders that have no page, and a link to one of them 404s. - `ai/2026-09-22/talk/page.js` has an `` with a document-relative src, which 404s under any deeper url. That bug predates this change. Doc: [core/Page/doc/markdown.md](/framework/core/Page/md/doc/markdown/)
